reviews.title: Awesome budget case
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this case!! Its super clean and feels really good quality. The top metal piece of the case is great! The cables are also in white which is awesome. For $100 you’re getting a good deal with 3 pre installed RGB fans. Definitely would recommend
reviews.author: Rosa Gonzalez

reviews.title: Bent/Broken RGB Pins
reviews.comment: The only issued I had was that the pins on the tower for the RGB leds were bent and broken. I was able to workaround that defect by using my MoBo's connectors.
reviews.author: Richard Rothery
